records.primary_location: Text section 3.5; Figure S8 mentioned but not provided in input
records.notes: Text states CO2 conversion was maintained at 4%, and CH3OH selectivity did not drop during 100 h time on stream; no numeric CH3OH selectivity printed in the main text.

extraction_notes: Main exact catalyst-performance table is Table 3. Selectivity/product-distribution data are said to be in Supporting Information Figures S5–S7, and the stability trace in Figure S8, but those SI figures are not included in the supplied text/images; only numeric values stated in the main text were extracted. Figure 10 main-text plot values were extracted only where the point was unambiguously tied to 2Pd/CeO2-R and a labelled condition; these are marked with qualifier '~' except the text-printed STY of 22.8 at GHSV 6. The paper defines CO, CH4, and CH3OH selectivities from molar outlet concentrations and converted CO2 in Experimental section 2.3, so selectivity_basis is recorded as carbon_molar even when selectivity values are not available.
